system.description:
You can shrug off blows that would leave a mortal staggering. When you suffer lethal or bashing damage, make a Simple Test. If you win, you may remove one level of damage from that suffered. You may spend a Stamina-related Physical Trait before the test to win on a tie.

Using Resistance is reflexive and does not count as an action. You may use Resistance on damage that was reduced to lethal from aggravated by Resilience. You may only use Resistance once for a given source of damage.
